{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and drop QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter to only completed orders (refunded orders are not revenue)
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
df_revenue_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
print(df_revenue_by_channel)"}
